title: Grim Reaper Chess
description: A hooded skeletal Grim Reaper with a glowing eye hovers above a chessboard, manipulating golden rings and orbs. The board shows toppled black and white chess pieces, lit candles, and a melting clock dripping over the edge onto a dark mound.
prompt: A hooded skeletal Grim Reaper with one glowing eye floats above a cracked marble chessboard, manipulating glowing golden rings and orbs with both hands. Scattered and toppled black and white chess pieces lie among several lit white candles on the board, with a large melting golden clock dripping over the front edge. The Reaper stands on a dark textured mound against a hypnotic background of concentric circles and soft glowing orbs in black, white, and gold tones.
